name: HyperTransfer
author: Luca Burchietti

sections.description:
This lightweight plugin enables fast file transfers via direct links, using your own web space. It serves as a reliable alternative to traditional file transfer services, with the added benefit of no expiration on transfers. Files remain securely stored on your private web space, allowing clients to access them anytime through a dedicated download page.

Special Features

  1. Upload, copy link and download.
  2. When the file is downloaded a notification arrives via email
  3. File management from the plugin page to delete files
  4. Download counter

Localization

  • English (default)

A plugin from 3skel.it

Feedback

sections.installation:
1. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  2. One new admin bar is ready for upload and manage files.
sections.faq:
What is the maximum size of uploadable files?

The tests is up to 2.0 Gb but it’s probabily it can work with larger file.

Why is it advantageous to use HyperTransfer?

  1. You can decide when to delete the file from the server and make it no longer available.
  2. The file to be transferred is stored inside your site’s server so it is probably in a place where only you can access it. If they are private or confidential files this is a good reason to use HyperTransfer.
  3. The user who has to download the file will be able to see the page where the download link is inserted, by doing so we will show him on the page, promotions, portfolio, images and whatever we like (in pro version, coming soon).

What can you do within the admin panel?

You can delete the files, see if the file has already been downloaded, copy the quick link (the download will start immediately).
